content.comment_body: Hello, This summer I installed a system to measure speed using an encoder (see the provided program) and control it with a valve. It worked well. Now, I'm trying a similar setup but with a limit switch, meaning I have only one pulse to calculate the actual meters per minute. For this purpose, I'm measuring the time interval between pulses (as shown in the attached program). The radius is 5 cm, and after counting, I calculate the meters per minute. Please review my program and let me know if this approach seems correct.
Hello all, Do you have any suggestions or comments about using a single limit switch for this? Is this the right approach?
Hello, Are there any concerns about measuring speed with only one pulse? I have separated the code to address this, and I am waiting for your feedback.
